description: This is a unit test class for the ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It contains test cases that validate the mapping logic for creating 'Thing' objects from external messages with various header and template configurations.

classes.name: ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapperTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the mapping logic of ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper, focusing on creating 'Thing' objects with various header and template scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: JUnit setup method initializing the test environment before each test case.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithCommandHeaderPlaceholder
methods.description: Test for mapping with a command header placeholder, verifying that the resulting 'CreateThing' signal contains correct entity and attribute data.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithDeviceIdPlaceholder
methods.description: Test for mapping with device ID placeholder, verifying correct 'Thing' creation.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithPolicyPlaceholder
methods.description: Test for mapping with a policy placeholder, verifying correct inclusion of initial policy.

methods.name: doForwardMappingTwice
methods.description: Test that multiple mappings in sequence produce distinct 'Thing' objects with correct identifiers.

methods.name: doForwardWithoutPlaceholders
methods.description: Test for mapping when the templates do not contain placeholders, expecting direct value substitution.

methods.name: throwErrorIfMappingConfigIsMissing
methods.description: Test that an exception is thrown if the mapping configuration is missing or invalid.

methods.name: throwErrorIfThingIdIsMissingInConfig
methods.description: Test that an exception is thrown if the 'thingId' is missing from the mapping template.

methods.name: throwErrorIfHeaderForPlaceholderIsMissing
methods.description: Test that an exception is thrown when a header required for placeholder substitution is missing.

methods.name: getFirstMappedSignal
methods.description: Helper method extracting the first 'Signal' from the list of adaptable results.

methods.name: createValidHeaders
methods.description: Helper method creating a standard set of headers for use in mapping tests.

methods.name: createExpectedThing
methods.description: Helper method to construct a 'Thing' object with specified IDs and attributes for verification.

methods.name: createMapperConfig
methods.description: Helper method to create a sample mapper configuration with provided templates for testing.
